newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Markets quiet as corn sinks.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Markets quiet as corn sinks.

text.p: A steady decline in CBOT corn futures this week kept buyer interest light in U.S. millfeed markets, millfeed dealers said.
CBOT corn futures were down 2-1/2 to 4-1/2 cents per bushel in late trading, with December at $2.89-1/4 per bushel. On Monday, December corn closed at $2.96-3/4.
The drop in corn futures was expected to pressure prices for all feed ingredients. In the Pacific Northwest, barley was competitively priced, sapping demand for millfeeds.
"There is a lot of Canadian barley coming in," a Portland dealer said.
In the Southeast, demand from feedmixers has fallen sharply as catfish and poultry farms are using less, Carolina sources said.
